raw_answer_text:
Looking at this task: this is a `flowchart` genre figure (procedure with a decision point), version `0.1` is sufficient (flowchart's floor is `0.1`), and it needs one EXPERIMENTAL (experimental) construct for the grouping box, which the router notes is reachable through `reference/experimental/flowchart.md`. I'll flag that in the file itself since it's outside the normative core.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive change request"
process validate "Validate against policy"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change to device"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Roll back"

# Grouping box is an experimental flowchart construct (EXPERIMENTAL);
# it states which steps fall inside the scheduled maintenance window
# and carries no other meaning.
group window "Change window" {
  validate
  apply
}

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
isvalid -> rollback "no"
apply -> confirm
```

Notes:
- All six nodes use the requested ids and shapes (`process`, `decision`, `terminator`).
- The five requested edges are present, with the decision's two branches carried as labeled edges (`"yes"` / `"no"`) out of `isvalid`.
- `validate` and `apply` are enclosed in a single labeled group box, `"Change window"`, per the request.
- Titles aren't rendered by default (`--with-title` opts in); the `title` line still documents the figure's purpose for the host Markdown caption.

Before treating this as finished, run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js change-request-procedure.fd` and fix any `Line N:` errors it reports — I can't execute the builder from here, so this file is authored to the documented grammar but not yet build-verified.
